sections.text: The southbound connector to northbound SR-133 /in Irvine/ (Orange Co) is closed 24 hours a day thur 0500 hrs on 9/18/26 - Due to construction - Motorists are advised to use an alternate route A high wind advisory is in effect from the Jct of SR-126 to the Los Angeles/Kern Co Line - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads Southbound traffic is reduced to 3 lanes at Camino De Plaza /in San Diego/ (San Diego Co) - Due to an overturned vehicle
A high wind advisory is in effect from the Jct of I-580 to the Jct of I-205 (San Joaquin Co) - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
